message.content: {"caption":"A five-series line chart compares model accuracy across tolerance settings for different training-data splits.","description":"The chart plots Accuracy (%) on the vertical axis, with a displayed range beginning at 60%, against categorical Tolerance (%) ticks of 10%, 5%, 1%, 0.1%, and 0.00% from left to right. The y-axis uses 5-point grid intervals. The legend identifies five colored series: base (pink), 5% (gold), 10% (green), 15% (blue), and merge-unique-skills (purple). All series decrease as the tolerance setting moves from 10% toward 0.00%. The base series is lowest at every tick. The merge-unique-skills series is highest or tied for highest throughout; it is nearly level with the 10% series at 10% and 5%, and leads at the remaining ticks. The 10% and 15% series meet at about 0.1%; the 5% series lies between these higher-performing lines and base. Values are estimated from the plotted markers, not printed next to
